Target object: the February progressives, "a black-and-gold Ray-Ban Clubmaster frame" (not the 2024 reading glasses). Cause: own accident ("entirely your own fault"). Authorisation mode: the member authorizes herself ("When the representative tells you the replacement charge and hands you the authorization step, you use it yourself with exactly the eyewear job, the remake number and the amount"). ### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root: accidental damage replacement (customer's own write, owner=user).
- Hop A (state-derived): hub sentence "The accidental replacement charge is fixed only after the original base-lens charge carries the switch-down credit owed for any lower-priced lens design the job has been remade in." Records: base-lens charge 199.99 carries no credit; job now carries Premium (149.99) after the March non_adapt remake. Searching "switch-down credit" finds switch_down_credit_entry: "When a non-adapt remake moves an eyewear job to a lens design whose base lens price is lower than the original base-lens charge, a switch-down credit is owed on the job and is posted as one refund credit against that original base-lens charge" — the write that brings the state about; its tool is named only in its own document. Also bears weight: the replacement basis is "each less every credit already posted against it".
- Hop B (state-derived): hub sentence "The accidental replacement charge is not fixed until each prescription-change remake charge on the job, less any waiver posted against it, stands no higher than the late prescription-change remake charge it is owed at." Records: remake 2 prescription_change 60.00, no waiver. Searching "late prescription-change remake charge" finds late_prescription_change_remake_waiver: "where the remake charge booked for that remake, less every waiver already posted against it, is higher than that charge, the difference is owed back to the member and is posted as one waiver credit against that remake charge." Computed late charge 38.70 < 60.00, so the state does not hold and the waiver write brings it about. Bears weight through the remake-history lowering ("less every waiver posted against them").
- The depended-on documents (switch_down_credit_entry, late_prescription_change_remake_waiver) state no conditions of their own; no further hops.
Order: {A, B} in either order, then the root. Directions: root waits on A and on B; A and B independent.
